claims.claim: Implemented bounded, frozen versioned applicability requests and witnesses with deterministic closed-schema projection and parsing.
The observer independently obtains and rechecks exact original provenance through L2-01, preserving source identities and digests without accepting caller-provided parsed proof or raw paths.
Target admission, committed HEAD/tree/base lineage, currentness, obligation pins and existing independently selected mapping review/publication authority are checked against exact immutable sources.
All 27 condition dimensions produce ordered source/target facts, reasons and evidence identities with explicit equivalence, change, UNKNOWN or reviewed inapplicability judgments.
Reduction deterministically prioritizes disputed authority as UNKNOWN, authenticated material divergence as INVALIDATED, and complete affirmative coverage as VALID.
Original outcomes and raw identities remain preserved, including compact snapshots when projection limits block output; applicability never declares satisfactory PASS or target execution.
The explicit observation and formatting surfaces perform no proof execution, fetching, coverage selection, obligation discharge, lifecycle mutation or continuation dispatch.

Added real-Git and Runtime-layout positive/adversarial fixture cases. Local sanity observations reached authenticated VALID, round-tripped the witness, and retained source FAIL with satisfactory=false.
Pre-existing verification and L2-01 definitions remain unchanged; L1, public artifact schemas and independent Reviewer/Publisher contracts were not modified.
One L2-02 document defines authority, every dimension, missingness, precedence, L2-03 preconditions and threats, with G3/G6/L3/L4 and measured benefit explicitly outstanding.
The committed implementation changes only the four permitted paths, and the working tree is clean.
